[center][b]

[size=6][b]Accord Settings[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]One shared settings interface for compatible Stardew Valley mods.[/i][/size]
[b]Version 0.1.0 — Public Beta[/b]
[/b][/center]
[line]
[center][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OkI1Kae.png[/img]
[/b][/center]
[b]Accord Settings is a configuration platform for Stardew Valley mods. It provides one shared and consistent settings interface for all compatible mods.
Instead of opening separate configuration menus, players can browse registered mods, search through their settings, switch between pages, and manage their configuration from a single unified interface.
The framework includes its own navigation system, configuration profiles, themes, diagnostics, controller support, and a public API for mod developers.[/b]
[center][b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49382/49382-1784505373-863516135.png[/img]
[i]The main Accord Settings interface.[/i]
[/b][/center]
[line]
[center][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4l0BzH8.png[/img]
[/b][/center]
[list]
[*][b][b]Shared mod settings browser[/b] with pages, categories, search, sorting, and favorites.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Public settings API and SDK[/b] for mod developers.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Configuration profiles[/b] with support for saving, loading, duplicating, backing up, importing, and exporting.[/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Mouse, keyboard, and controller navigation.[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][b]Custom themes[/b], accent colors, panel styles, and interface size presets.[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][b]Transactional controls[/b] with Apply, Save, Cancel, and Reset functions.[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][b]Built-in diagnostics[/b] for settings, UI, translations, input, and performance.[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][b]Optional GMCM compatibility[/b] for supported registrations.[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][b]Translation support[/b] for the framework and compatible mods.[/b][/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[center][b][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/iQBD9wy.png[/img]
[/b][/b][/center]
[b][b]Accord Settings supports a wide range of configuration controls:[/b][/b]
[list]
[*][b][b]Toggles[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Sliders[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Dropdowns[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Numeric fields[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Text fields[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Keybinds[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Color controls[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Color picker[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Pages and sections[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Tooltips[/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b]Dynamic option states[/b][/b][/*]
[/list][b][b]Compatible mods can register their settings through the public API without needing to create a completely custom configuration menu from scratch.[/b][/b]
[center][b][b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49382/49382-1784505508-804652415.png[/img]
[i]Settings displayed in Accord Settings.[/i]
[/b][/b][/center]
[line]
[center][b][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UC89oRa.png[/img]
[/b][/b][/center]
[b][b]The interface can be customized with themes, accent colors, panel styles, borders, readability settings, and coordinated interface size presets.
Predefined layout presets automatically adjust panels, icons, controls, borders, and spacing to keep the interface clear at different screen resolutions.[/b][/b]
[center][b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49382/49382-1784505676-650401668.png[/img]
[i]Dark theme with custom controls and live preview.[/i]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49382/49382-1784505670-1765488763.png[/img]
[i]Classic theme inspired by Stardew Valley.[/i]
[/b][/center]

[line]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/D4KnAbG.png[/img]
[/b][/i][/center]
[i][b]Configuration profiles allow players to create and manage complete mod configurations.[/b][/i]
[list]
[*][i][b]Create multiple profiles.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Save current settings.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Load existing profiles.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Duplicate profiles.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Use separate profiles for different save files.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Create automatic backups.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Import and export configurations.[/b][/i][/*]
[/list][center][i][b]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49382/49382-1784505681-1610383923.png[/img]
[i]Configuration profile management.[/i]
[/b][/i][/center]
[line]
[center][i][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vdvZpIF.png[/img]
[/b][/i][/center]
[i][b]Accord Settings includes its own controller navigation system for:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*][i][b]Main tabs[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Mod lists[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Configuration pages[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Control settings[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Dialogs[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]On-screen keyboard[/b][/i][/*]
[/list][i][b]Controller support is part of the framework interface, so integrated mods do not need to implement a separate navigation system.[/b][/i]
[line]
[center][i][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/FCeGQL2.png[/img]
[/b][/i][/center]
[i][b]Accord Settings provides a public API and SDK for Stardew Valley mod developers.
The API can be used to:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*][i][b]Register a compatible mod.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Create configuration pages.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Add categories and sections.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Register standard setting controls.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Access theme information.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Work with configuration profiles.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Display custom actions and diagnostics.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Respond to saved or changed settings.[/b][/i][/*]
[/list][quote][i][b]
Developer documentation and integration examples will be expanded throughout the public beta.[/b][/i][/quote][line]
[center][i][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nP3KtrZ.png[/img]
[/b][/i][/center]
[i][b]General Mod Config Menu is optional.
When GMCM is installed, supported registrations can be imported into the Accord Settings browser. Complex or unsupported custom controls can continue using the original GMCM interface as a fallback.
Accord Settings does not replace or include GMCM. Mods using the native Accord Settings API can work without GMCM.[/b][/i]
[line]
[center][i][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/B1DJv2u.png[/img]
[/b][/i][/center]
[list]
[*][i][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/i][/*]

[/list][line]
[center][i][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PI4qpXJ.png[/img]
[/b][/i][/center]
[list=1]
[*][i][b]Install SMAPI.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Download Accord Settings.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Extract the [b]AccordSettings[/b] folder into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] directory.[/b][/i][/*]
[*][i][b]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/b][/i][/*]
[/list][line]
[center][i][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/U0Il6ES.png[/img]
[/b][/i][/center]
[i][b][b]Does Accord Settings replace GMCM?[/b]
No. GMCM is optional and can still be used as a fallback for unsupported or highly customized controls.
[b]Will all mods automatically appear in Accord Settings?[/b]
No. Mods must support the Accord Settings API or use a compatible imported registration.
[b]Does Accord Settings work without GMCM?[/b]
Yes. Mods using the native Accord Settings API do not require GMCM.
[b]Does the framework support controllers?[/b]
Yes. Controller navigation is built directly into the framework interface.
[b]Is this a finished release?[/b]
This version is a public beta. Bugs, visual changes, and API modifications may still occur.[/b][/i]
